generic_ballot.source_label: PollingForecast-compatible merged poll archive (RCP plus existing poll inputs)
generic_ballot.display_type: polling average, not an election-day forecast

external_poll.status: public context only; not included in the district forecast

generic_ballot.margin_definition: D/R two-party margin: 100 × (D share − R share) / (D share + R share).
generic_ballot.timing_rule: Primary timing policy: include measurement fieldwork ending by 2026-10-27; exclude only verified first-public dates after the cutoff. Unknown first-public dates remain unknown and are retained. The current local input package was captured at 2026-10-27T21:32:02.844730Z; this is not an end-of-day-complete feed. The full live PollingForecast API snapshot was unavailable.
generic_ballot.source_coverage_note: Weighted poll averages use the frozen Oct25 merged feed plus audited direct-source additions; the full live archive could not be snapshotted.

Senate.coverage_note: 35 forecast races plus 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus, 31 Republican).

Governor.coverage_note: Covers 36 Governor races; source coverage is documented in the private release audit.

senate_seat_distribution.interpretation: Approximate range across the listed Senate races and seats already held; not a party-control probability.

summary.seat_range_note: Seat ranges aggregate the reconstructed release probabilities under an independent-race assumption.

governor_seat_distribution.interpretation: Range of Democratic wins among listed Governor races; not a party-control probability.
